description: Permanently deletes a specific checklist from a Trello card.

idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card from which the checklist will be deleted. The card must exist.
idCard.title: Id Card

idChecklist.description: The ID of the checklist to delete. The checklist must exist on the specified card.
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

name: delete_card_checklist

DeleteCardChecklistResponse.description:
Response schema for `DeleteCardChecklist`

Empty response body. The DELETE operation returns HTTP 200 OK status with an empty
or null response body upon successful deletion of the checklist from the card.
DeleteCardChecklistResponse.title: DeleteCardChecklistResponse
